name: GRIET Central Library
hours: Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Closed on Sundays and public holidays.
borrowing_rules: Students can borrow up to 4 books at a time for a period of 14 days, renewable once if no reservation is pending.
late_fee: Rs. 2 per book per day after the due date.
facilities: Digital library with e-journals and e-books
